ose_jpx.nine_digit_rule_note: The 8th-9th digits are the target index/product classification. For Nikkei 225 Micro Futures the official target-index classification is 23. The first seven digits remain contract-specific under the futures identification-code rules and must be generated/read from the actual contract master rather than guessed from a vendor ticker.

nikkei_225_micro.rule: Opening date is not equivalent to availability of every minute-data source.
